item.title: [+1] Sensex adds 308 points to 74,459.53; Nifty reclaims 23,000 but midcaps and smallcaps fall up to 2%
item.description:
IT and pharma led; pharma gained about 7% over the week. Nifty rose nearly 2% on the week after last week's losses. Second straight up day; broad market weak.

IT services: mild tailwind (+1) — IT buying

Why it matters: A stronger rupee, the Fed pause and earnings support large caps, while high crude weighs on smaller, more domestic companies.

Market gauges: Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: [−1] Rupee gains 33 paise to 94.93 per dollar on RBI intervention and softer crude
item.description:
It traded between 94.94 and 95.28; the dollar index slipped to 101.66. Biggest gain in weeks after holding near 95.3. Easing pressure.

IT services: mild headwind (−1) — Lower export earnings

Why it matters: A firmer rupee trims the cost of imported oil and inputs and supports foreign investor returns.

Market gauges: Rupee +1, Inflation outlook +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days
